description: Set the scale (zoom) and offset of a layer or group within the .icon bundle. Use to zoom the glyph in/out or reposition it.

layer_index.description: Layer index within the group (0-based, required for target=layer)

scale.description: Scale factor (0.05-3.0, where 1.0 = full size, 0.5 = half, 2.0 = double)

target.description: Whether to set position on a layer or group

name: set_layer_position
